new.note: Whole cauliflower baked under a bubbling cheddar sauce, carried in and carved at the mess table.
new.how: Boil a whole cauliflower for 8 minutes, drain well and sit it in a baking dish. Melt 40g butter, stir in 40g plain flour for a minute, then whisk in 500ml milk until thick. Off the heat stir in 150g grated cheddar, 1 tsp mustard and salt. Pour over the cauliflower, top with 50g more cheddar and 30g breadcrumbs and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Carve at the table.

r2.make_ahead: Make the cheese sauce up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; boil and bake on the day

steps.text: Boil the whole cauliflower for 8 minutes, drain well and sit it in a baking dish.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for a minute, then whisk in the milk until thick.
Off the heat stir in 150g of the cheddar, the mustard and a pinch of salt.
Pour over the cauliflower, top with the rest of the cheddar and the breadcrumbs and bake at 200C until golden, 25 min.
